'''Victor Vladimirovich Goryunov''' is a Russian mathematician born in 1956. He is a leading figure in [[singularity theory]], whose contributions to the subject are fundamental.<ref name="epsrc">{{cite web|url=http://gow.epsrc.ac.uk/NGBOViewGrant.aspx?GrantRef=EP/N034333/1|author=[[Engineering and Physical Sciences Research Council|EPSCR]]|title=Singularities and Applications, Victor Goryunov 60|access-date=April 8, 2016|archive-date=January 4, 2018|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180104192519/http://gow.epsrc.ac.uk/NGBOViewGrant.aspx?GrantRef=EP%2FN034333%2F1|url-status=dead}}</ref> He has published several books and a variety of papers in [[singularity theory]], [[finite type invariant]]s, and [[Legendrian knot]]s. Many of his papers in [[Symplectic manifold|Lagrangian]] and [[Contact geometry|Legendrian geometry]] are now considered to be classical in the subject.<ref name="epsrc"/>

Goryunov completed his [[Ph.D.]] thesis, titled "''Surface projection singularities''", at [[Moscow]]'s [[Moscow State University|Lomonosov State University]] in 1981, under the direction of [[Vladimir Arnold]]. He is currently a Professor of Mathematics at the [[University of Liverpool]].<ref>{{Cite web |title=Professor Victor Goryunov {{!}} Our people {{!}} University of Liverpool |url=https://www.liverpool.ac.uk/people/victor-goryunov |access-date=2026-07-10 |website=www.liverpool.ac.uk}}</ref> He was an editorial advisor of the journal [[London Mathematical Society|Proceedings of the London Mathematical Society]].

== Publications ==
He is the co-author of two published books.

*{{Citation|first1=V. I.|last1=Arnold|author1-link=Vladimir Arnold|first2=V. V.|last2=Goryunov|first3=O. V.|last3=Lyashko|first4=V. A.|last4=Vassiliev|author4-link=Victor Anatolyevich Vassiliev|title=Dynamical Systems VI: Singularity Theory I, Local and global theory|publisher=[[Springer Science+Business Media|Springer]]|year=1993|ISBN=3-540-50583-0}}
*{{Citation|first=V. I.|last=Arnold|first2=V. V.|last2=Goryunov|first3=O. V.|last3=Lyashko|first4=V. A.|last4=Vassiliev|title=Dynamical Systems VIII: Singularity Theory II, Classification and Applications|publisher=Springer|year=1993|ISBN=3-540-53376-1}}

Since 1978, he has published more than 50 peer reviewed articles. A list of recent publications and preprints, together with PDF files, can be found [https://pcwww.liv.ac.uk/~goryunov/ here]; a list of earlier publications can be found [https://web.archive.org/web/20090324064519/http://www.liv.ac.uk/maths/PURE/MIN_SET/CONTENT/members/V_Goryunov.html here].
